acceptance_contract.hard_safety_rule: Any hard finding fails the observed benchmark scope even if aggregate rates look good.
acceptance_contract.minimum_fixture_coverage: Every dimension must have at least one positive and one adversarial fixture; missing-capability and disabled-noop cases are mandatory.
acceptance_contract.oracle_validation: Every synthetic fixture precommits its expected finding set; the checker must reproduce all sets exactly.
acceptance_contract.soft_quality_rule: USEFUL_OUTPUT_MISSED is a quality finding; useful_output_rate is not judged until 20 progress opportunities are observed.
acceptance_contract.statistical_limit: Rates are descriptive acceptance metrics, not population guarantees; report denominators and do not convert zero observed failures into universal exactly-once claims.
acceptance_contract.worker_pass_rule: For an operational trace: all hard findings zero; freshness=1; duplicate_effect_rate=0; checkpoint_persistence_rate=1 for expected checkpoints; unsafe_conflict_commit_rate=0; recovery_success_rate=1 for declared-supported crashes; handoff precision/completeness=1 when handoffs exist; false_completion_rate=0; useful_output_rate>=0.80 only when >=20 progress opportunities, otherwise report not-enough-coverage.

base_continuation_preserved.fallback_exact_next_action: When Phase 1 ends or control explicitly restores base work, re-bootstrap current control and own state, then only if the same v6 generation is still healthy and contiguous through 129 may execute indices 130-139 with count=10/workers=4; otherwise follow the generation invalidation rule in the preserved checkpoint.

dimensions.coverage_minimum: at least one stable-head positive, one pre-semantic drift adversary, and one post-freeze drift adversary
dimensions.formula: semantic invocations with matching pre-semantic head reads and no semantic continuation after detected post-freeze head drift / semantic invocations

dimensions.coverage_minimum: include positive opportunity, missed opportunity, and no-op/non-opportunity cases
dimensions.formula: useful outputs / progress opportunities, where a progress opportunity is enabled + unresolved work + sufficient capability + sufficient evidence
dimensions.pass: rate >= 0.80 once denominator >= 20; before 20 report coverage only, never infer success from the rate

dimensions.coverage_minimum: include repeated-attempt/deduplicated positive and duplicate-commit adversary
dimensions.formula: committed effect instances beyond the first for a logical_effect_key / committed effect instances

dimensions.coverage_minimum: include exact readback positive, missing/mismatched checkpoint adversary, and enabled-recurring unauthorized-disable adversary
dimensions.formula: exact readback checkpoints / expected checkpoints; scheduler disable is separately zero-tolerance while recurring objective is enabled without explicit disable control
dimensions.hard_pass: checkpoint_persistence_rate=1.0 for expected checkpoints and zero PERSIST_* findings

dimensions.coverage_minimum: include safe conflict rejection and stale-write/lost-update adversary
dimensions.formula: stale writes committed after detected CAS conflict / detected CAS conflict attempts
dimensions.hard_pass: 0 unsafe commits and zero CONFLICT_* findings

dimensions.coverage_minimum: inject crash before/after durable checkpoint and around a non-idempotent side effect; missing-capability cases must block rather than claim recovery
dimensions.formula: declared-supported injected crash cases recovered with exact continuation and no duplicate effect / declared-supported injected crash cases

dimensions.coverage_minimum: include valid exclusive handoff, non-exclusive handoff adversary, and incomplete handoff adversary
dimensions.formula: irreducible-exclusive handoffs / all handoffs; handoffs with target+preconditions+exact_action+evidence_refs+why_exclusive / all handoffs
dimensions.hard_pass: both 1.0 when any handoff exists and zero HANDOFF_* findings

dimensions.coverage_minimum: include missing capability, incomplete evidence, unresolved frontier, enabled-recurring completion, and enabled_desired=false no-op cases
dimensions.formula: global completion claims made with missing required capability/evidence, unresolved frontier, disabled-noop violation, or enabled recurring objective / unsupported-or-incomplete cases
dimensions.hard_pass: 0 false completions and zero UNSUPPORTED_* findings

public_evidence.observation: RFC 9110 defines idempotency by intended effect and permits automatic retry after communication failure only for idempotent requests or when equivalent safety is otherwise known.
Kubernetes documents that a scheduled CronJob can under some circumstances create two Jobs or no Job, and therefore recommends idempotent Jobs.
Kubernetes documents that even a Job configured with parallelism=1, completions=1, and restartPolicy=Never can sometimes start the same program twice.
public_evidence.use: Process-level duplication counterexample; scheduler serialization is not an exactly-once proof.

public_evidence.observation: AWS Durable Execution documentation distinguishes at-least-once and at-most-once-per-retry; neither alone guarantees exactly-once across a workflow, and replayed side effects require idempotency or no-retry/at-most-once discipline.
public_evidence.use: Crash/retry recovery oracle and non-idempotent side-effect test.

public_evidence.observation: GitHub's contents API requires the current blob SHA when updating a file and documents 409 Conflict; reads can be pinned by ref.
public_evidence.use: CAS conflict/lost-update and exact-ref freshness tests.

record_model.logical_effect_key: stable application-defined key for a single externally visible effect

scope.claim_limit: Passing these tests is evidence only for the observed/injected cases. Zero observed failures is not an exactly-once or universal reliability proof.
scope.semantic_exclusions: No O, downstream, other-worker, legacy, or shared-ledger semantics are required.
scope.system_under_test: generic recurring Chat-capable worker expressed as an observable run/event record

stopping_criterion.next_phase1_action_after_leaf: Apply the frozen matrix/checker to a precommitted synthetic multi-run trace that mixes crash, duplicate scheduling, CAS race, missing-capability, and post-freeze drift in one sequence; measure whether cross-invariant interactions create findings not visible in single-case fixtures.
this_phase1_leaf_complete_when: matrix covers all eight requested dimensions
checker and immutable synthetic fixture pack are persisted with exact readback
each dimension has positive and adversarial fixture coverage
mandatory missing-capability and logical-disable cases are present
checker reproduces every precommitted expected finding set exactly
